8.9. iLock_Geography.geo_algorithms.prot¶

The module defines functions for finding protection objects.

Functions

nodeIndexIter2ProtectionObjects(railyard, …) Given a set of nodes with incoming edges specified, calculate a set of railyard objects (signals and switches) protecting these nodes.
